name: compass-writing-style
description: Use this skill when drafting or editing any COMPASS paper content, including abstract, introduction, related work, method section, results, discussion, limitations, appendix, pre-registration document, or dataset documentation. Covers house style for framing, notation, pre-registration disclosure, and handling of confirmatory vs exploratory results. Do not use for code documentation, which has its own conventions.
author: s-haider10
